Text Overflow

Text-overflow: clip

This is a very long text that should be clipped at the edge of the container without any ellipsis

Text-overflow: ellipsis

This is a very long text that should have an ellipsis at the end when it overflows

Word-wrap: normal (default)

Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious is a very long word that may not break properly

Word-wrap: break-word

Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious is a very long word that should break to fit

Multiple lines with overflow hidden

Line 1 - This is some text content

Line 2 - More text that should be hidden

Line 3 - This line should not be visible
